value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor starts with a chance of a shower, maybe a thunderstorm early on, then it clears by late morning and turns sunny and hot. Around 29 in the afternoon, feeling like 35 with the humidex. It gets gusty in the afternoon, with gusts up to about 50 km/h, and a shower is possible overnight.
